text:
Leo T.: hi team, very quick onboarding question — just joined and trying to access a dev service secret in Vault. I tried `vault login` with my SSO but got a 403 when running `vault kv get secret/projects/gamma/api_key`. What am I missing?

Jenna M.: welcome Leo! :wave: default new-hires get a `secrets-dev` role for dev namespaces but you need to request explicit path access for project-specific secrets. Did you file the onboarding secrets request?

Leo T.: not yet. I wasn't sure whether to open an issue in the Portal or ping infra. What's the minimal info to include so it doesn't sit in triage?

Samir R.: best route is the onboarding portal (https://internal.redwood.dev/onboard). Minimal fields: project slug, environment (dev/staging), exact Vault paths, reason, duration, and your @github. Example:```nProject: gamma
Env: dev
Vault paths: secret/projects/gamma/api_key
Reason: run local integration tests and reproduce bug #452
Duration: 14 days
GitHub: leoto
```

Jenna M.: also add `kms-decrypt` tag if you need KMS grants. For decrypts we map service account -> KMS key. If it's a human user we usually provision a short-lived session credential.

Leo T.: ok, and if I need to run a script that calls KMS to decrypt blobs locally?

Samir R.: tag the ticket `kms-local-decrypt` and attach the minimal IAM policy snippet from the guidelines page. The ticket will route to Platform Security and Ops; for dev tasks they often approve same-day. The policy example (copy into ticket):```n{"version":"1","statements":[{"effect":"allow","actions":["kms:Decrypt"],"resources":["projects/*/locations/*/keyRings/*/cryptoKeys/dev-*"],"condition":{"Bool":{"kms:KeyUsage":"true"}}}]}```

security-bot: Automated: Please do not paste sensitive values in tickets. Use path names only. See https://internal.redwood.dev/security/kms-guidelines and https://internal.redwood.dev/security/vault-onboarding.

Jenna M.: small pro tip — for local workflows prefer using our secrets helper that injects values into env vars instead of writing files. e.g. `secrets-helper fetch --path=secret/projects/gamma/api_key --export` or `vault kv get -field=value secret/projects/gamma/api_key | secrets-helper mask`. That avoids accidental commits.

Leo T.: sweet, I'll open the portal ticket now with the template and attach the IAM snippet. Appreciate the quick help!

Samir R.: ping me if approval stalls, I can fast-track small dev requests. Also set duration to the minimum you'll need — security will ask to renew for longer work. :thumbsup:
